claim.statement: Google's current Jules FAQ says Jules is currently in Public Beta.

limitations: The FAQ is rolling documentation and does not identify when its Public Beta wording was added or last reviewed.
The label is publisher-attributed and was not independently verified.
unknowns: Whether the current wording is intentional, stale or limited to an unstated region, plan, account cohort or surface is unknown.
The current backend build and release state for any particular Jules task are unknown.

relationships.note: The current publisher FAQ says Jules is in Public Beta, while the dated publisher changelog says Jules is no longer in beta; no attributable correction or scope explanation resolves the lifecycle disagreement.
